summary:
Both §9.4 failures in the Rust prototype are fixed. Each fix is backed by a native test that fails on the round-3b binaries (digests checked) and passes on the new ones, on darwin-arm64 and in a Linux arm64 container. The full harness 2.4.2 passes 139/139 on both platforms, with status verified.

1. K6e child self-stop (prototypes/rust/src/runner.rs). The wait loop now also reads stop and continue reports. It consumes them with waitid calls that leave out WEXITED, so the child is still not reaped before forwarding is disarmed. If the child's stop is still in place after 200 ms with no continue or exit report, heimdall-proto sends the same stop signal to its own PID only. It falls back to SIGSTOP when the signal isn't TSTP/TTIN/TTOU or was inherited as ignored. The shell then reports the job stopped, and fg/bg continue both processes because they share a process group. The grace period exists because, after a terminal Ctrl-Z, fg can continue heimdall-proto before the child, and mirroring that stale stop re-stopped the job after fg (seen once in 3 runs with the grace set to 0). Test: pty case k6e-child-self-stop-bash in tests/pty_tui.py.

2. K12 closed stdout (prototypes/rust/src/main.rs). Plain output of version, profile show and agent list now ignores write errors, as the --json path already did. The exit status therefore depends only on the result, and all 7 cases match with and without --json. Test: k12_closed_stdout_exit_parity in tests/cli.rs.
